events.title: Beaded Pumpkin Keychain
events.desc: IKEA Family signup required. Create your own colorful fusible beaded pumpkin keychain in a welcoming, creative space where everyone can express themselves. events.title: Kitchen Services Workshop
events.desc: IKEA Family signup required. Learn from our specialists the steps to create the kitchen of your dreams. Get your questions answered by our knowledgeable team and discover the range of services IKEA has to offer. All you need to bring is your imagination! Our team is ready to inspire you and help you realize the full potential of your kitchen space, no matter the size or your budget. Partner with us to make your dreams a reality! *Must be an IKEA Family member to register. Check in with a co-worker in the Kitchen planning station located in Level 2 showroom.

events.title: Berkeley – The Three Sisters: Corn, Bean, and Squash
events.venue: West Branch – Meeting Room, 1125 University Ave., Berkeley
events.desc: Experience an interactive celebration of Native American Heritage at West Branch. The highly interactive experience includes fun with elderberry clapper sticks, storytelling, singing, 7-ft tall corn husk puppets, and more. This program is for children ages 4 and up.

events.title: Holiday Ornament Decorating
events.desc: IKEA Family signup required. Join us for our Holiday Ornament Decorating, where you’ll decorate your own festive ornament to add a personal touch to your holiday décor. We’ll provide the ornament and decorating materials—you bring the creativity! Make something for your own tree, create a handmade gift for someone special, or simply enjoy a relaxing evening of holiday crafting. No crafting experience needed—just come ready to make something merry!

events.title: Read to a Dog
events.venue: Temescal Branch · In the Children's Area
events.desc: Did you know that some dogs love to listen when new or experienced readers practice reading aloud? Our furry friends Navi and Barley are gentle, trained therapy dogs who patiently listen to reading-age kids & tweens as they gain confidence to read out loud. Drop by on the second Monday of each month to read with Navi and Barley! Get accessibility information .

events.title: Gnome in the Home Scavenger Hunt
events.desc: Gunnar the gnome has escaped from the holiday shop and made himself at home throughout the IKEA Emeryville showroom! Follow the Showroom path to see where he's hiding and get ready for a picture-perfect surprise in the Swedish Restaurant!

events.title: Holiday Toy Drive at IKEA Emeryville
events.desc: Join us in bringing a little extra joy to local children and families this holiday season. Now through December 10, when you visit IKEA Emeryville, you can purchase a children's toy, small or medium soft toy, game, or craft supply and donate it to a child in our community. Simply place your new, unwrapped donation in the collection bin located just beyond the checkout registers. All donations will support local families through our partnership with UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, helping make the holidays a little brighter for children in need. Together, we can create a joyful holiday season
